description: Brief 33: TaskFailureDetails as the orchestrator receives them, captured by tools/capture-failures (no Azure): real exceptions built by the SDKs or thrown by the runtime, through the Functions worker's own conversion (TaskFailureDetailsConverter.TaskFailureFromException with the app's IExceptionPropertiesProvider, ExceptionProperties.Of), then ProtoUtils back to Microsoft.DurableTask.TaskFailureDetails. The SqlException server message is synthetic: shape only; no real capture yet (a server's text cannot be captured offline; brief 34's live resume never reached the Durable layer, because EF's own retries absorb it). The classifier reads the sqlErrorNumber property, never the text.
